notes.title: Update 18th.Jul.2021
notes.notes: The operability of diagonal movement using the Game pad has been greatly improved.

notes.title: Added many voices and suspend function
notes.notes:
Added nearly 30 new voices for the main characters "Alice" and "You" each!
　Also, the bonus for reaching 100% has been increased from x3000 to x5000 points.
　Added a new suspend function. You can use it by pressing the S key while pausing. To restart the game, press the F9 key on the title screen.

notes.title: Added voice and setting auto save
notes.notes:
Added voices.
"GAME SETTINGS" and "SOUND SETTINGS" settings are now saved.
The default setting for moving by pressing the same directional key twice has been changed to "No".
(This can be changed in "GAME SETTINGS" -> "DIRECTION MOVE")
